The rice used in this rich risotto permeates the light flavor of the salmon.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Salmon Risotto can be made by [[Cooking]] a [[Hearty Salmon]], [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The only way to make regular Salmon Risotto is by adding a fifth ingredient that grants an effect other than hearty. Eating these [[Meal]]s will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. This Risotto is known the be rich, as the rice permeates the light flavor of the Salmon. In [[Ivee's Diary|her diary]], [[Ivee]] details a recipe for [[Mushroom Risotto]]. However, at the end, she suggests substituting the [[Hylian Shroom]]s used with Hearty Salmon for a "fish-lover's dish".{{Cite|Note: Use a {{Color BotW|Blue|hearty salmon}} instead of {{Color BotW|Blue|Hylian shrooms|link}} for a fish-lover's dish.|Ivee's Diary|BotW}} Link can only make one variation of Salmon Risotto: * '''Hearty Salmon Risotto''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Salmon Risotto}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The rice used in this rich risotto permeates the light flavor of the salmon.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using the default recipe. When these meals are consumed, all of Link's Hearts will be healed, and he will gain temporary Hearts. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} Like in {{BotW}}, Salmon Risottos are made by [[Cooking]] a [[Hearty Salmon]] with [[Hylian Rice]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Rock Salt]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal * Salmon Meunière }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Risottos, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
